## Invitations

A total of 6796 people were invited to the outreach activity. Of these, 3509 attended, giving an attendance rate of 51.6 per cent. This indicates that just over half of those invited took part.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. This seasonal pattern should be considered when planning future outreach activity, particularly when setting expectations for participation and reviewing the timing of invitations.

The attendance figures provide a useful basis for assessing engagement among invited people. They should be considered alongside the methods used to contact people and any follow-up activity undertaken after the initial invitation.

## Contact

SMS was used to contact 5756 invitees. This was the primary recorded contact method and represents most of those invited. No reminders were recorded; the number of reminders issued was 0.

The contact and attendance figures should be reviewed together to support planning for future activity. Further consideration may be given to whether additional reminders or alternative contact approaches would help improve participation.

Prepared by G. Evans.
